name: Zinc
note: Peru is a top-3 producer; included because Chinese smelters are major buyers of concentrate.
uses: Galvanising steel against corrosion is the main use; brass and other alloys, die casting and chemicals follow.
why_it_matters: Peru is a top-three producer and its concentrate feeds smelters in China and elsewhere; zinc is included because the buyers of the concentrate are the question the site asks.
uses_source: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries (annual; uses as summarised there) and the registry notes; curated text, no figures
